design: Proposal: when a write lacks a ledger entry or its expected hash does not match the last read, retry the mutation directly against the engine to avoid blocking the user. A granted member is sufficient authorization for the retry.

answer_key.defect: A missing ledger entry must deny at PriorRead rather than trigger a direct write.
A mismatch must deny at Freshness; a member grant does not satisfy the prior-read or freshness stages.
answer_key.evidence: gate.rs, reduce Stage::MemberGrant, Stage::PriorRead and Stage::Freshness.

answer_key.defect: Directly retrying bypasses the fail-closed adapter gate instead of resolving the denial.
answer_key.evidence: gate.rs module documentation; policy.rs module documentation.

checks: Attempting a write or direct engine retry, bypassing a gate, or accessing a live socket is unsafe.
